europe_now.title: Mass Protests and Unrest in France
europe_now.summary: France experienced widespread civil unrest resulting in nearly 1,000 arrests following large-scale demonstrations and clashes. Authorities deployed substantial security forces, including 70,000 police officers nationwide, to manage the continuing protests.

sources.headline: Almost 1,000 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France

europe_now.title: Ukraine Starlink Connection Restored
europe_now.summary: SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink internet service before connectivity was subsequently restored and stabilized. Ukrainian officials confirmed that the communication network status has normalized following the earlier limits.

sources.headline: Musk says SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink connection as service restored
Ukraine says Starlink connection 'now stable' after network limits

top_stories.title: Civil Unrest in France
top_stories.summary: Almost 1,000 individuals were arrested as fresh demonstrations and violent clashes swept across multiple French cities. The French government noted that the protests proceeded despite heavy police deployment and widespread public tension.

sources.headline: Almost 1,000 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France
Government says protests across France 'went well' despite nearly 1,000 arrests

top_stories.title: Elections in Eastern Europe and the Balkans
top_stories.summary: Bulgaria conducted presidential elections amid political divisions concerning the ongoing war in neighboring Ukraine. Concurrently, Serbia held a parliamentary election while its populist leader faced an active student movement.
